signature_info.description: Microsoft® Windows System Restore Delayed File Renamer

attributes.magic: PE32 executable (native) Intel 80386, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is identified as the legitimate Microsoft Windows component 'System Restore Delayed' (SRDelayed.exe). It is a Native subsystem application designed to perform critical file operations (move, delete, and rename) during the early boot phase that were initiated by System Restore but could not be completed within a standard user session. Key behaviors include: 1) Enabling high-level system privileges such as SeRestorePrivilege, SeBackupPrivilege, and SeShutdownPrivilege via RtlAdjustPrivilege. 2) Parsing a dedicated operation file via NtReadFile to execute deferred file system changes. 3) Updating restoration status in the registry under 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\SystemRestore'. 4) Managing persistence via the 'Session Manager\SetupExecute' registry value. 5) Initiating a system reboot using NtShutdownSystem upon completion. These actions, while powerful, are consistent with documented system maintenance and restoration procedures.
